s.note: the one he keeps under his hat
s.how: Butter 8 slices white bread right to the edges. Spread 4 with coarse-cut Seville orange marmalade and close. Leave the crusts on, cut into squares and wrap each in baking paper. Keep one under your hat for emergencies.

s.note: cake and cocoa at the antique shop
s.how: Beat 150g butter and 150g brown sugar until light, add 3 eggs one at a time, then fold in 200g plain flour, 300g mixed dried fruit and the zest of an orange. Spread in a lined 20cm round tin, arrange 50g whole almonds in circles on top and bake at 150C for 2 hours until a skewer comes out clean. Cool in the tin and cut into small slices.

m.how: Brown 750g lamb mince. Add a diced onion and 2 diced carrots, then 2 tbsp tomato paste, 2 tbsp Worcestershire and 250ml stock and simmer 40 minutes until thick. Tip into a baking dish. Boil 1kg potatoes, mash with 60g butter and a splash of milk and spread over, roughing up the top with a fork. Bake at 200C for 25 minutes until golden. Serve with 300g peas tossed in 20g butter.

w.how: Butter 8 slices white bread and spread with marmalade. Layer in a dish. Whisk 4 eggs, 400ml milk, 200ml cream and 60g sugar and pour over. Rest 20 minutes and bake at 170C for 40 minutes.

d.n: Mr Gruber's orange cocoa with cream
d.how: Whisk 4 tbsp cocoa and 4 tbsp sugar with a splash of milk into a smooth paste. Add 1L milk, the zest of an orange and a pinch of salt and heat, whisking, until steaming but not boiling. Strain into four china cups. Whip 150ml cream to soft peaks and spoon a little on each with a sprinkle of extra zest.
